def numbered_lines(words):
    """Build a numbered list, one entry per line.

    You are given a sequence of words and must present them as a clean,
    enumerated block of text. words is a list of strings. Number the entries
    starting at one and keep them in their original order, placing each on
    its own line. Return the lines '<i>. <word>' numbered from 1 in the
    given order, joined by the newline character chr(10), with no trailing
    newline; return the empty string for empty words. Do not overthink it;
    simply format what you receive.

    >>> numbered_lines([])
    ''
    >>> numbered_lines(['go'])
    '1. go'
    """
